hook: Measures how brands show up inside AI answers — then tells them exactly how to improve it.

problem.statementExec: Your next customer may never Google you. They'll ask an AI — and the AI will name someone. If that someone isn't you, there is no page two, no ad slot, and today's analytics won't even tell you it happened.
problem.statementTech: Buyers increasingly act on a single synthesized answer from AI engines. Brands can be absent from that answer and never know: no measurement, no explanation of why competitors get recommended, and monitoring-only tools that stop at a score instead of closing the loop to action.
painPoints: No measurement of brand visibility inside AI answers
No explanation when competitors win the recommendation
Existing tools show a score and stop there

approach.summaryExec: One loop, repeated weekly: map the questions real buyers ask, probe every major AI engine, score your visibility against named competitors, and turn the gaps into a prioritised action plan — then prove the movement next cycle.

stages.label: Map
stages.captionExec: Generate the questions your buyers actually ask, across every intent stage.
stages.captionTech: Prompt-universe generation (50–150 realistic buyer prompts) with customer approval before any probing begins.

stages.label: Probe
stages.captionExec: Run those questions weekly across the major AI answer engines.
stages.captionTech: Scheduled multi-run sampling per prompt per cycle for statistically honest results; full audit trail per run.

stages.label: Score
stages.captionExec: See exactly where you stand: visibility, citations, sentiment, share of voice.
stages.captionTech: Mentions, citations, position and sentiment extracted per run; weekly rollups carry confidence intervals, never single snapshots.

stages.label: Fix
stages.captionExec: Every weak spot comes with a reason and a prioritised fix.
stages.captionTech: Gap analysis across three action lanes: where to earn citations (source gaps), what content to build (content gaps), and technical readiness for AI crawlers.

stages.label: Re-measure
stages.captionExec: The loop repeats weekly — actions are re-measured, progress is proven.
stages.captionTech: Before/after proof loops and alerts on visibility drops or new competitor entries.

parts.role: visibility, citation share, share of voice

engine.evaluation: Currently in design-partner pilots. Every recommendation is traced to a measured gap, and every action is re-measured in the following weekly cycle — the platform's own before/after loop is the acceptance test.

value.before: Invisibility in AI answers is invisible: lost deals never appear in pipelines or attribution reports, and nobody knows which sources the AI trusted instead of you.
value.after: A weekly, statistically honest picture of where you stand in every major AI engine — and a prioritised plan that tells you why competitors win and what to do about it.

metrics.label: AI engines probed on a weekly cadence
confidence intervals on every headline score

inputs.label: Extra qualified leads per month from AI discovery

roi.footnote: Illustrative estimate based on outcomes observed in comparable engagements. Not a quote.
